name: Mengqi Zhang
interests: My research focuses on robust and generalizable embodied intelligence, spanning world models, 3D perception, and robot learning. I am interested in how models acquire physical understanding from visual experience, and how we improve their ability to reason and act in unfamiliar environments.

news.text: 🤖 DeVA project page and robot demos are live!
🎉 SMF-VTO presented as an oral at the CVPR 2026 AI4CC Workshop.
🎉 WFM-Eval accepted to CVPR 2026 workshops: Video World Models & FMEA.
🎉 SPOT accepted to CVPR 2026 workshops: MUSI & Visual Concepts.
🎓 Moved to UC Irvine with Judy Hoffman’s group.
💼 Joined Amazon as an Applied Research Scientist intern.
🎉 MeshFormer presented as an oral at NeurIPS 2024.
🎓 Started my Ph.D. at Georgia Tech with Judy Hoffman.

papers.title: DeVA: Decoupled Video-Action Model with physical guidance for robot policy learning
papers.authors: Mengqi Zhang, Sahil Khose, Simar Kareer, Yuchen Song, Unnat Jain, Judy Hoffman
papers.image_alt: DeVA robot performing a bimanual handover
papers.summary: Transferring visual and physical priors from video models into robot policies, with strong generalization and up to 20× fewer training examples than the baseline.

papers.title: WFM-Eval: Interpretable Error Diagnostics for Video World Models in Robotics
papers.authors: Sahil Khose, Mengqi Zhang, Prithvijit Chattopadhyay, Judy Hoffman
papers.image_alt: WFM-Eval taxonomy of object hallucination and temporal consistency errors
papers.summary: Diagnosing failures that standard video metrics miss: five world models, two robot datasets, and links to downstream policy performance.

papers.title: SPOT: Structured Prompting with Object-centric Tokens for open-world scene graphs
papers.authors: Mengqi Zhang, Sahil Khose, Fiona Ryan, Judy Hoffman
papers.image_alt: SPOT predicting spatial and semantic relationships between objects
papers.summary: Spatially and semantically grounded scene graphs with open-source VLMs, including cross-domain generalization and zero-shot 3D transfer.

papers.title: Style-Instructed Mask-Free Virtual Try-On
papers.authors: Mengqi Zhang, Qi Li, Mehmet Saygin Seyfioglu, Karim Bouyarmane
papers.image_alt: Virtual try-on results with natural-language control over garment styles
papers.summary: Mask-free virtual try-on with natural-language control over garment types and wearing styles.

papers.title: MeshFormer: High-Quality Mesh Generation with 3D-Guided Reconstruction Model
papers.authors: Minghua Liu*, Chong Zeng*, Xinyue Wei, Ruoxi Shi, Linghao Chen, Chao Xu, Mengqi Zhang, Zhaoning Wang, Xiaoshuai Zhang, Isabella Liu, Hongzhi Wu, Hao Su

papers.title: HOIDiffusion: Generating Realistic 3D Hand-Object Interaction Data
